page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.32xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.g8a family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor with an x86_64 architecture, running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance features 128 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be fulfilled via network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware. However, it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfer between instances and external services. The absence of local storage and GPU accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, prioritizing high-density CPU and memory resources over localized disk performance or hardware-accelerated graphics processing.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g8a.32xlarge offers a high-density resource profile suitable for large-scale deployments that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation without the overhead of physical hardware management. It is designed for workloads such as enterprise-grade web serving, distributed databases, large-scale container orchestration, and application servers that require substantial parallel processing power and balanced memory allocation.
